item.title: Despite No Disc, GTA 6 Recorded the UK's Biggest Physical Launch Since 2019
item.description:
People love plastic boxes.

GTA 6 has been breaking records all over the place, so it doesn't come as much of a surprise to learn that its performance at physical retail has been mighty impressive.

As reported by The Game Business, based on data from UK tracker Nielsen IQ, GTA 6 has recorded the country's largest physical launch since 2019's FIFA 20. Turns out only the nation's love of football can compete.

item.title: New Phantom Blade Zero PS5 Update Brings Features, Upgrades, and Fixes
item.description:
Out on Saturday, 28th November.

Phantom Blade Zero studio S-Game has announced the game's next PS5 patch will arrive this Saturday, 28th November 2026, weighing in at around 7GB.

It's already posted the patch notes ahead of pushing the PS5 update live at the weekend, and they reveal new features, technical enhancements, and bug fixes coming to the game.

item.title: Feature: Everything You Need to Know Ahead of the Delta Force Invitationals Grand Final
item.description:
The tactical shooter’s 3-day LAN championship kicks off in Sweden this weekend - with huge in-game rewards for tuning in.

After last year’s inaugural event in Hangzhou, this weekend sees the Delta Force Invitational make its first move outside Asia, as an official competitive title at DreamHack in Stockholm, Sweden, from 27th-29th November. The Grand Final of the tournament will take place on November 29th at 11am UTC+0 through to 4pm UTC+0 after three days of global competitive action.

item.title: PS Plus Premium Members Can Try One of This Year's Best Games in a 2-Hour Trial
item.description:
Take Star Wars: Galactic Racer for a spin.

Everyone is (understandably) going gaga over GTA 6 right now, but real ones will know that 2026 has also brought us one of the best racing games of the PS5 generation — Star Wars: Galactic Racer.

The arcade racing title is the debut effort from Fuse Games, and it's tremendous. If you're a PS Plus Premium member, you don't need to take my word for it.

item.title: Hitman, 007 First Light PS5 Crossover Makes Lenny Kravitz Your New Ally
item.description:
Available now for free on PS5.

It's a bit surprising this crossover hasn't already happened, to be honest, given IO Interactive is the studio behind both of the games, but it's now been confirmed a Hitman and 007 First Light collaboration is happening.

The content is live from today until 24th December 2026, and it takes the form of a new Elusive Target in Hitman. Lenny Kravitz, who is playing Bawma from 007 First Light, is the next celebrity to feature in Hitman, but this time, he's on Agent 47's side.

item.description:
A Witcher's work is never done.

The Witcher 3 Remastered has a new update on PS5, and it's available to download right now, weighing in at a reasonable 1.6GB.

Patch 5.02 is the one many have been waiting for, as it addresses the game's most annoying technical issue on console. I am, of course, referring to the momentary stutters that occurred when autosave was triggered.

item.title: PS Plus Essential's Next Update Looks a Bit Better in Japan Than the Rest of the World
item.description:
A different lineup overseas.

It’s all subjective, of course, but Japan’s PS Plus Essential update for December 2026 looks a little bit better than what we’re getting in the west.

While all regions will receive Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3 + 4 and Dragon Ball XenoVerse 2, subscribers in the far east will get an extra helping of anime, with Bleach Rebirth of Souls. The rest of the world will get Amnesia: The Bunker instead, as reported yesterday.

Digital PS4 owners get a free upgrade.

item.title: Final Fantasy Resonance Devs Surprised by How Many Fans Wanted a Traditional, Turn-Based RPG
item.description:
Action (not) required.

Final Fantasy Resonance has been one of the most positively-received Square Enix games in ages — but its developers were never fully convinced that it would, er, resonate on the scale that it has.

Producer Keisuke Nakashima told Japanese outlet Game*Spark (as translated by Automaton): "I was surprised to see just how many people, not only in Japan but overseas as well, are eager for the kind of FF they remember from back in the day, with classic turn-based battles and pixel art."

Read the full article on pushsquare.com

item.title: PS5's Most Overlooked Action Game of 2026 Gets a Complete Edition Next Year
item.description:
Nioh's the time.

Nioh 3 is getting a 'Complete Edition' early next year, Koei Tecmo has confirmed. It'll include the base adventure alongside its two expansions, Hell Rising and Bloody Insurrection.

The latter isn't actually out yet — it launches on the 17th December, and promises a brutal all-out battle between multiple factions. Your character will, naturally, be tasked with carving out a solution to the bloodshed.

item.description:
Good luck getting one.

Sony’s struggling to meet demand for the PS5 following last week’s release of GTA 6.

Many major retailers in the US, including PS Direct, are currently completely sold out of the system – although you may find isolated instances of stock in stores.

item.title: Skate PS5 Moving Away from Seasons, Adds Proximity Chat, New Mode, More in Next Update
item.description:
Changing the game.

Skate, the free-to-play skateboarding game that's still in Early Access, is ditching its seasonal approach moving forward, publisher EA has confirmed.

The always-online, shared world game has been getting fairly regular updates since its launch back in September 2025, and it's all been modelled around Seasons. Following the next update — 0.33, launching 1st December — this system will be dropped.

item.title: Cyberpunk 2 Development Really Ramping Up as Team Targets Big 2027
item.description:
Everyone's Chippin' In.

2027 will likely be a pivotal year for Cyberpunk 2 as it rockets towards full production, with CD Projekt Red anticipating significant expansion to the sequel's development team.

Since the summer, the number of people working on Cyberpunk 2 has increased from 184 to 199, which doesn't seem like much, but this is a steady process.

item.title: CD Projekt Red Expects GTA 5 to GTA 6-Like Upgrade in The Witcher 4
item.description:
"You should expect us to make a bigger jump".

CD Projekt Red thinks it can deliver the same sort of "leap" in The Witcher 4 as Rockstar Games has just accomplished going from GTA 5 to GTA 6.

The 13-year gap between instalments in the GTA series has allowed Rockstar Games to create the "greatest open world game ever made", as our GTA 6 PS5 review explains. Within that, it's created a more mature look at the world and then delivered incredible and immersive content alongside it.

item.title: Another Big PS5 Game Will Be Delisted in the Coming Months
item.description:
Exoprimal goes extinct like its dinosaurs.

Capcom has announced it'll be delisting its multiplayer dinosaur shooter Exoprimal in March 2027, and then turning the game's servers off in September.

The news comes from an "end of service announcement" published on the official Exoprimal website, where it is said: "We cannot thank you enough for the love and support you have shown over the years, and we sincerely apologize for the gravity of this announcement."
